name: real-twin-dumbbell-strength-circuit-20260913
description: REAL saved doc (13 Sep 2026), strength part only. A 4-set circuit of 10 Dumbbell Bench Press (two dumbbells, 35kg each), a 15m twin Kettlebell Front Rack Carry (16kg each) and 8 Toes to Bar. Every twin lift must print per implement ('2×35kg', '2×16kg') and the top set must read '2×35kg' — never the summed 70kg the breakdown stores for volume. Before the fix the bench line read '70kg' directly above a carry reading '2×16kg', under a 'TOP SET 70kg' hero.
